description: Source code for the 'bbolt' database implementation, including database management, transaction handling, memory mapping, and file locking mechanisms.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: Represents a Bolt database, managing file access, memory mapping, transactions, and internal state.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Configuration options for opening and managing the database.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Holds performance and usage statistics for the database.

classes.name: Info
classes.description: Provides internal information about the database's memory mapping.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the file path of the open database.

methods.name: GoString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the database for debugging.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the database.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens or creates a database at the specified path with given options.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the database and releases resources.

methods.name: Begin
methods.description: Starts a new transaction, read-only or writable.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Executes a function within a writable transaction, committing on success.

methods.name: View
methods.description: Executes a function within a read-only transaction.

methods.name: Stats
methods.description: Retrieves current performance and usage statistics.

methods.name: Page
methods.description: Retrieves a page reference from the memory map by page ID.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Returns the current meta page, validating and selecting the most recent valid one.
